candidates.description: This vector represents subword fragments and characters commonly found in Hindi script and Hindi-language text tokenization.
This vector is related to character n-grams and morphological sub-word units in the Hindi language script.
This feature vector represents Devanagari vowel sign 'ā' combined with various semivowels, nasals, and lateral consonants to form common Hindi syllable clusters and word endings.
This feature vector activates on Hindi and Sanskrit conjunct consonants involving the anusvara and virama.
This vector activates strongly for Hindi Devanagari script characters and subword tokens.
This vector represents common Hindi characters, syllables, and words.
This feature vector represents common suffixes and root endings used in Hindi verb inflections for tense, gender, and number.
This vector is related to sub-word units and character n-grams commonly found in Hindi script.
These tokens represent various non-English diacritical marks, punctuation symbols, and specialized foreign script characters.
This vector is related to fragments and components of words written in the Devanagari script.
